$comment: Package names this repository has retired, and the paths still allowed to mention them (TASK-OSS-P1-01). Data, not code: adding a retirement is an edit here, not a change to validate-package-names.ts. This file is itself allowlisted — it has to name the retired strings to forbid them.

retired.name: @dzup-ui/pro
retired.reason: Never existed. The Nuxt module transpiled it, the resolver emitted it, and the resolver spec asserted it, so `includePro: true` shipped green while producing an unresolvable import for every consumer who followed the docs (reassessment finding H1).

$allowlistComment: Historical records: a changelog entry, a shipped changeset, an ADR, or an audit finding states what was true when it was written, and rewriting it would falsify the record. `dist/**` is build output regenerated by `yarn build`, and `docs/program-2026-08/**` is the program that specifies this very repair. The release-data files are generated FROM changelog and changeset text, so they inherit the allowlist their sources already have -- the same paths eslint.config.js ignores as generated output.
$escapeComment: A file outside the allowlist may still name a retired package where naming it IS the point — a migration note, or a test asserting the name is never emitted. Put `retired-name-ok:` plus a reason on the same line or the line directly above.
